The data used in this are fictional practice data. Relative paths help reproducibility 
because it allows someone else to run the code on their computer without changing the paths, since they won't have the same absolute paths as you. freeze: auto only reruns what has changed when you rerender[^1] so the whole things doesn't rerun. 

[^1]: using "quarto rerender"
